# rustdoc allowed by default

Every stable rustdoc lint that is allowed by default as of Rust 1.100.

| Lint | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`missing_crate_level_docs`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/rustdoc/lints.html#missing_crate_level_docs) | detects crates with no crate-level documentation |
| [`private_doc_tests`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/rustdoc/lints.html#private_doc_tests) | detects code samples in docs of private items not documented by rustdoc |
| [`unescaped_backticks`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/rustdoc/lints.html#unescaped_backticks) | detects unescaped backticks in doc comments |
